invalid.rule: Intervals for the same dish and date must not overlap (they may touch).
discarded + donated + carried_over must not exceed prepared - sold (here 3 + 1 + 1 > 4).
Menu versions of one dish must not overlap; the second starts on the day the first ends.
Opening-hours periods of one weekday must not overlap.
dish_id must exist in the dataset.
(date, dish_id, time_slot) must exist in the CSV: dish-05 is served at lunch only.
Every hourly observation must include time_slot (lunch or dinner).
Timestamps must include an explicit UTC offset.
Intervals must stay inside the observation date.

versioning_sequence.note: Identical retry: returns the current version and does not rerun analysis.
Changed payload with a stale expected_version; stored snapshot unchanged.
Full replacement: GET /operations then returns 30 days, not 35, and cost 3.9 from 2025-09-20.
All-or-nothing: an invalid import leaves version 2 and its results intact (expected_version in the file is irrelevant).
